name: Fake Roads
storyline:
You are trying to reach your girlfriend’s apartment at the end of the street.
The door number is 10.
But something isn’t right.
The streets feel familiar…
but they’re not exactly the same.
Objects move.
Details shift.
Things appear where they shouldn’t.
Sometimes the changes are subtle.
Sometimes they’re impossible to ignore.
Observe your surroundings carefully.
Spot the anomalies.
Choose the correct path.
summary: Fake Roads is an observation-based exploration experience where the smallest changes can alter everything.
